Wednesday Joy Ride

Sioux Falls, SD · Social

Wednesday Joy Ride is a social group ride in Sioux Falls, SD. It rolls third Wednesday of the month at 6:30 pm from Sioux Falls Bicycle Company.

Next ride Wed, Oct 21, 6:30 PM CDT

How we know

Sioux Falls Bicycle Company's events page lists the Wednesday Joy Ride (pub ride, third Wednesday monthly, 6:30 pm) as a series running May 20 to Sep 16, 2026; no October date is posted (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at @sfbicyclecompany the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Wednesday Joy Ride group ride

A monthly pub ride. The group leaves the shop, rides to a pub, has a beer or two, and rides back. Adults only in practice, easy pace.
